steps.say: Opposites mean very different things. Hot and cold are opposites.
Big and small are opposites too. So are up and down.
Some words go together in a group. Apple, banana and orange are all fruit.

figure.alt: An apple, a banana and an orange.

steps.say: If one word does not fit the group, it is the odd one out.

check.prompt: What is the opposite of big?
hints: Think of an elephant and a mouse.
check.explanation: Small is the opposite of big.

options.why: Large means the same as big.
